H1.claim: Incoming-weight alignment reduces transferred edit error relative to raw coordinate transfer between independently trained networks of the same architecture.
H1.primary_endpoint: paired difference raw-minus-aligned target-region output-0 edit RMSE, normalized by requested shift; one disjoint source/target pair per unit
H1.support_rule: paired bootstrap 95% interval lower endpoint above zero; no claim of exact semantic transfer between independent networks
H1.positive_control: known permutation and positive ReLU scaling of the same trained model
H1.negative_control: raw-coordinate edit transfer after a hidden permutation
H1.source_program: the retention-aware compiled source edit, regardless of behavioral admission; rejected edits evaluated only in isolated numerical experiments

H2.claim: Including a retention term during readout compilation reduces held-out collateral output drift while retaining useful target edit gain.
H2.primary_endpoint: paired reduction in held-out retention RMSE across all three output coordinates versus target-only compilation; one source network per unit
H2.support_rule: bootstrap 95% lower endpoint for collateral-drift reduction above zero and mean target gain at least 50% of requested shift
H2.negative_control: a parameter-bounded edit may still violate a behavioral drift contract
H2.limits: exact box admission is a deterministic guarantee about score drift, not an empirical proof of improved reward
H2.target_gain_definition: mean change of output 0 on held-out target-region inputs, divided by requested shift

H3.claim: A validation-selected increase to the RTS recruitment preference improves held-out simulation utility at a maximum 420-second horizon without a higher observed loss count.
H3.primary_endpoint: paired utility difference from baseline, utility = opponent town-center damage fraction - own town-center damage fraction + 0.02 * completed recruited soldiers
H3.support_rule: paired bootstrap 95% lower endpoint above zero and candidate observed loss count no higher than baseline; this is not a statistical noninferiority test
H3.limits: one mission/ruleset and frozen opponent; utility is a declared proxy, not a general strategy metric

statistical_policy.units: disjoint independently initialized source/target network pair for H1; its source network for H2; world seed for H3; conditional on the fixed shared synthetic data partition
statistical_policy.multiplicity: three exploratory hypotheses, unadjusted intervals; no confirmatory significance claim
statistical_policy.selection: retain every candidate; fixed synthetic training/compilation without adaptive model selection; select RTS candidate using validation only, then evaluate its frozen bundle once on test
statistical_policy.missing_or_failed_runs: retain failure reasons; never silently exclude; hypothesis remains inconclusive if planned units incomplete

networks.dataset: fixed deterministic nonlinear three-output regression teacher on bounded continuous inputs
networks.train_loss: mean squared error on fixed nonlinear teacher logits
networks.optimizer: full-batch Adam, fixed epochs, CPU float64
networks.edit_spec: raise output 0 by 0.75 on states with x0 > 0.35, retain outputs outside that region
networks.independent_transfer_pairing: 20 disjoint adjacent seed pairs; first member is source, second member target; no network reused across H1 units
networks.H2_units: the 20 source networks, one per disjoint H1 pair
networks.H1_error_definition: output-0 RMSE of transferred changes minus the retention-aware source edit realized changes on held-out target-region inputs, divided by requested_shift
networks.data_distribution: independent coordinates Uniform[-1,1]; one shared fixed disjoint data partition, inference conditional on this partition

rts.selection_rule: highest mean validation utility subject to loss rate no higher than baseline; ties prefer smallest absolute delta; baseline eligible
rts.protected_region: train_army feature equals zero, all other features in [0,1]
rts.fixed_opponent: authored commander-v1 using actual mission rival legality and timing

protocol_note: Fixed before results. Before first execution, cyclic overlapping transfer pairs were replaced by disjoint pairs to make the declared bootstrap units independent conditional on data. Before any outcomes, endpoint wording was clarified to match implemented output coordinates, disjoint units, validation-only RTS selection, and observed-loss guard. No outcome-dependent tuning is authorized.
